findings.text: The log's '# command:' line is composed as `PYTHONPATH=. JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu <python> -m pytest ...`, but the arm is executed at line 73 as `env PYTHONPATH="${tree}" ...` after `cd "${tree}"`. The two agree only because the wrapper changes directory first, so a promotion harness that replays the recorded command from any other working directory imports a different tree than the arm did; the log does carry '# tree:' so a reader can recover, but the recorded command is not the one that ran.

`_export` writes a revision's tree with `git archive | tar` and `_run_arm` runs and logs the arm, which re-implements the snapshot-and-run-an-arm capability scripts/prototypes/bank_warm_predictor/suites.py:13-90 already owns (its `snapshot` and `run`). The gained refactor moves the run half onto run_suite_arm.sh but leaves the export forked, so a future change to how an arm's tree is materialised must be made in two prototype trees.

The provenance paragraph cites job 1338142 as the claim verifier but names no revision, and the cited log input-drift/verify-input-drift-4.log carries `revision=ce4bf40077dc56999618770aa58e1dc9c1ad9719`, three commits before the reviewed head d90cdd78; verify_input_drift.py is unchanged across those commits, so the claims do apply to the head, but a reader comparing the provenance to the delivered head cannot see that from the record.
